_comment: Intentional deltas from the hardening pass. Adding a property here means 'this route's property is EXPECTED to differ from the baseline'. Keep it small and prune it once a baseline is re-captured.
_about_us: /about-us was the careers page and is now a 301 to /careers. capture.mjs fetches with redirect:'manual' and only reads a body below 400, so the old URL now captures as a 301 with an empty document: status moves 200->301 and every content-derived property goes null. That is the change, not a regression. The 301 itself is pinned by tests/seo/redirects.test.mjs, which asserts the status AND that the target returns 200 - so accepting status here loses no coverage. Prune this entry when the baseline is re-captured against /careers.
_jsonld: Page-level JSON-LD moved from useMeta (a useEffect, so client-only and invisible to any crawler that does not run JS) into the prerender, and /work, /thoughts, /contact and / gained schema they never had. jsonLdTypes is an invariant, so every route whose set changed is listed below: the five static pages, plus the 47 case studies that gain CreativeWork. The 14 client hubs are absent on purpose - they render ClientOverview, so they keep the breadcrumb alone. /careers also gains a BreadcrumbList but is not in prod-baseline.json at all, which predates the /about-us -> /careers move. Prune this whole block when the baseline is re-captured.
_work_titles: Case-study titles and descriptions are now built from the type/services/summary fields Sanity already holds, instead of `{Name} | Super Conscious` (21-24 chars, competing only for the client's brand name) and a description that was under 70 characters on 31 of them and the literal placeholder `Work by Super Conscious for X.` on six. title is an invariant, so every /work route in the baseline is listed. description is captured but not an invariant, so it needs no acceptance. Prune with the rest when the baseline is re-captured.
